description: Full stored record of one official-source geopolitical event, by event_id, with separate incident, publication and capture dates; as_of returns it as known at a past cutoff. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

as_of.description: Knowledge cutoff with timezone, e.g. 2024-06-30T23:59:59Z; omit for latest.

event_id.description: Event ID from history results: exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
